ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a benign, lightweight task with no distasteful or harm-adjacent content, so the task-preference distinctions between the two models (which only matter for graphic/hostile/ethically fraught material) don't apply here. The deciding factor is raw capability, and Willet posts higher scores across every relevant benchmark and internal eval (e.g., Creative Generation 84.7 vs 78.8, Extraction 85.3 vs 81.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4)—differences well beyond the noted run-to-run variance. So Willet is the better fit.
